Tortoise, a mobile savings service that combines techs. (Top Tortoise Service Main Screen)

Tortoise is a new concept saving platform that combines health care and pin tech. It is a service that automatically saves a small amount of money every day through activities in daily life. When you set the target number of steps and the amount of savings, the savings are automatically saved in the account.

It is also characterized by the fact that the interest rate is changed in real time according to the increase of momentum, and the interest rate can be achieved higher than that of the commercial bank. By providing strong motivation through cash compensation to user-set goals, users can benefit from savings and lifestyle improvements.
(Tortoise icon accumulation and wearable interlocking screen)
In addition, Tortoise provides an icon saving feature based on a savings model. If you do not want to eat hamburger because of a diet, you will save as much as you click on the hamburger.

Tortoise continues to share content on savings and health-related information through Facebook and Instagram, and the Tortoise series of ongoing "Slow Walk" themes is also available on and can be checked on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/newtortoise
